title: BART Green Line Weekend Closure for Train Control Upgrade
summary: The Green Line will not operate on the weekend of November 14-15, 2026, as BART installs new train control systems. Free shuttle buses will replace service between 24th St. Mission and Daly City.

title: Reduced Oakland Airport Connector Service During Maintenance
summary: Planned maintenance on the Oakland Airport connector will result in 9-minute average waits instead of the usual frequency, starting the night of November 14 through the following morning.
